chain.text: The clinic serves 4,200 patients with 12 nurses across three shifts. Key context: accreditation runs to April 2027 and renewal needs an infection-control audit. Attendance averages 180 daily (peak 310 in January 2025); no-shows fell to 9% after reminder texts. Two incidents drove current rules: a 2024 fridge failure requires temperature alarms and logging, and a record conflict now locks open records. Prescription renewals need a consultation within 12 months, vaccines are counted twice weekly, and temperature excursions must be reported same-day. A second ultrasound machine is postponed pending an unused utilisation study. The nursing coordinator post is vacant and rotationally covered, which the team says is unsustainable.
